# The 13.2 blog posts show the two-window and Fleet Manager frames

## Context

neomjs/pages#21 (merged 2026-10-09 16:50Z) hosts four frames under `resources_pub/website/release-notes/v13.2.0/`:
- `dock-d3-tear-out.png` (the tear-out, both windows in frame) and `dock-native-return.png` (the return), both cut from the 13.2 film take on real windows (#15252);
- `fm-1-fleet.png` and `fm-2-observatory.png`, the Fleet Manager frames the operator asked for: an active fleet and the Observatory.

All four `main` raw URLs answer 200. #19517 embeds them in the release notes. The two 13.2 blog posts still lack them.

## The Problem

- `learn/blog/a-workspace-that-can-leave-its-window.md` is about panes leaving their window, yet none of its three frames shows two operating-system windows: D1 and D2 show one window, and D4 a popup alone.
- `learn/blog/one-repository-per-reader.md` introduces Agent Institution in prose only, while its repository has almost no traffic.

## The Fix

Embed each frame like the posts' existing images (`<img … class="blog-image">`, then an italic caption that claims only what the frame shows), at `width="100%"`. The Portal wraps every Markdown image in a scrolling box and never scales it (#8479). At a 1440 px viewport that box is 685 px wide, so an 800 px frame hides its right 115 px, and in D3 that is the torn-out window. The Dock post's D1 and D2 move to `width="100%"` for the same reason; D4 (600 px) already fits.
- **Dock post:** D3 after the rail frame, where the text narrates the tear-out. The native return goes in "Green in emulation, broken by hand", after D4, as the real-window receipt.
- **Split post:** the fleet and Observatory frames in "What we build next: Agent Institution", after the paragraph that lists the roster and the activity.

No prose changes beyond the captions.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: The Dock post shows `dock-d3-tear-out.png` and `dock-native-return.png`, and the split post shows `fm-1-fleet.png` and `fm-2-observatory.png`, each from its pages `main` raw URL.
- [ ] AC-2: Each image has alt text and an italic caption that claims only what its frame shows.
- [ ] AC-3: A local Portal render shows both posts with the images inside the column.

## Out of Scope

- The release notes (#19517).
- New captures, and text changes beyond the captions.
